page.overview:
Who is Bazrak Bolgan?

Bazrak Bolgan was a Dwarf Brewmaster working for Josef Bugman.

An expatriate of the Dragonback Dwarf Hold and veteran of the Goblin Wars, by the time Bugman's Brewery was sacked by Git Guzzler, he was a very old and grumpy dwarf, with an enormous belly and infamous fiery temper. However, his skill as a brewmaster impressed even the great Bugman himself.

Shortly before the brewery was burnt down, Bazrak Bolgan was leading a convoy of beer carts down the Old Dwarf Road, when they were attacked by Grotsnag and his Wolf Bandits However, Bolgan escaped the ambush and was able to regroup with the rest of his forces. He later fought when Bugman's Brewery was besieged by Git Guzzler's horde. If he was not killed at that battle, he was carried off by the victorious goblins to an unknown fate.
